subject: Request to access cardinal S4 object - MSProcessedImagingExperiment

messages.author: 10bd092efeee6b91
messages.subject: Request to access cardinal S4 object - MSProcessedImagingExperiment
parts:
Hi Kylie

When performing Spatially-aware nearest shrunken centroids clustering, please let us know if there is a way to replace the abundance values and annotations of the m/z features with alternate measures such as externally pre-processed/normalized or modified data from custom data analysis pipelines in the  MSProcessedImagingExperiment S4 object. Our aim is to use the function 'spatialShrunkenCentroids' for segmentation of MSI dataset based on values other than signal intensities of metabolites. Please find the code that we have been using so far for performing spatial shrunken centroid clustering. We would really appreciate if you could let us know a way to access the 'data' object after applying the 'readImzML' function (line #2 in the code below) and perform the replacement of m/z feature values and their annotations.

#Reading Imzml ibd file
name <- "WTAG3_rep1"
data <- readImzML(name)
View(data)
summary(data)

#Pre-processing
norm_data <- normalize(data, method="tic")
smoothen_data <- smoothSignal(norm_data, method ="gaussian", window=9)
baseminus_data <- reduceBaseline(smoothen_data, method="median", blocks=50)
baseminus_data_new <- baseminus_data[,!duplicated(coord(baseminus_data))]
pickedpeaks_data <- peakPick(baseminus_data_new, method="adaptive")
alignedpeaks_data <- peakAlign(pickedpeaks_data, method="diff")
filteredpeaks_data <- peakFilter(alignedpeaks_data, freq.min=0.05)
processed_data <- process(filteredpeaks_data)

#Spatially-aware nearest shrunken centroids clustering
ssc_test <- spatialShrunkenCentroids(processed_data, r=6, k=5, s=c(0,1,2,3), method="adaptive")
image(ssc_test)

Regards
Farheen
